convert_rst_to_mdx: convert a reStructuredText document to MDX format with Svelte imports and framework-aware code blocks
convert_rst_docstring_to_mdx: convert a docstring written in RST to MDX with parsed parameters and return sections
parse_rst_docstring: parse an RST docstring into structured MDX with parameters, returns, and raised errors
convert_rst_links: convert RST-style links and references to markdown links with configurable package prefixes
split_pt_tf_code_blocks: split PyTorch and TensorFlow specific code blocks into framework-tagged MDX sections
